page.content:
Marquet campaign of Bells Hells and the Predathos arc.

How Campaign 3 connects

  • Faction: Bells Hells — Bells Hells are the player party of Campaign 3.
  • Character: Matthew Mercer — Mercer DMs Campaign 3 for Bells Hells.
  • Topic: Critical Role — Campaign 3 is Critical Role's Marquet campaign.
  • Work: Campaign 2 — Campaign 2 ended before Campaign 3 began.

What is Campaign 3?

Campaign 3 is the Bells Hells game set largely in Marquet, the campaign of Imogen, Laudna, and the Ruidus / Predathos plot that pulls in faces from the earlier parties.

Key threads lead to Bells Hells, Matthew Mercer, Critical Role and Campaign 2.
